reviewed_exact_row: 30000977 / OWR-1971-010: Is every complete canonical cover of a singular surface of minimal degree of degree at most 4? Original OWR 26/2008 pp.1462,1464: https://ems.press/content/serial-article-files/46169

New surfaces with canonical map of high degree — Christian Gleissner, Roberto Pignatelli and Carlos Rito; Communications in Analysis and Geometry 30(8) (2022),1811–1823. Prior full negative answer: a surface with nine A2 canonical singularities, ample base-point-free Cartier K, pg=4 and K²=24 has complete canonical map of degree 12 onto a singular rank-three quadric cone. The degree 27 construction cover is a different map. Mathematical source inspected: arXiv:1807.11854v2 §6; its group-rank and divisor-relation typos are explicitly repaired in PR #1021. Journal metadata verified; final journal body uninspected, no claim of identical wording/defects. Existing publication, no new upload or project-authorship/firstness claim. Audit: https://github.com/AlecKriebel/Math/pull/1021
